input.rationale: There is no limitation-of-liability, exclusion-of-damages or aggregate-liability language anywhere in the Agreement (Sections 1-10 reviewed in full), so both parties face unlimited direct and consequential exposure. We inserted a mutual cap at the greater of 12 months' fees and USD 1,000,000, a mutual consequential-damages exclusion, and uncapped Excluded Claims (confidentiality/data, indemnity, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, IP infringement), with Company payment obligations excluded from the cap.

input.quote: HDI agrees that the Company shall not be deemed in breach of any provision of this Agreement by virtue of the Globix Agreement remaining in effect
input.rationale: No indemnification, defence or hold-harmless language exists in the Agreement, despite HDI developing and hosting a consumer-facing Site under our brand and handling our customer data. We inserted HDI's indemnity for third-party IP claims relating to the Site, HDI's breach of law, data incidents and gross negligence/wilful misconduct, with standard procedure and a narrow reciprocal Company indemnity limited to our Content and our breach of law.
